**Static Partitioning:** Divide the image plane into $P$ contiguous rectangular blocks of comparable size.
**Tiling:** Divide each image block into fixed-size square image tiles.
**Assignment:** Statically assign each image block to one processor.
Each processor initializes its local task queue with the tiles in its assigned block.
**Initial Processing:** Each processor begins ray tracing the tiles in its assigned block in scan line order.

**Dynamic Grabbing:** When a processor finishes all tiles in its assigned block, it grabs an unprocessed image tile from the next processor in scan line order (processor $(i+1) \pmod P$) that has not yet finished its block.
**Continuation:** Processors continue to grab tiles from other processors' queues until all tiles are completed.
